status_effects.explanation: He is staged as the guest the entire household waited for and organized itself around, marking his admission into the valued Guermantes milieu.
He loses the anticipated timidity and moves with ease among the Guermantes, gaining composure in the scene.
Her physical grace and thoughtful attentiveness toward the narrator are presented approvingly, favorably characterizing her as hostess.

appraisal_events.evidence: "la crainte de me laisser voir qu'on n'attendait que moi pour dîner et qu'on m'avait attendu longtemps"; "paraissait susceptible d'être agrégé au milieu Guermantes"; "sans que j'éprouvasse l'ombre de la timidité que j'aurais pu craindre ... Je leur obéis avec d'autant plus d'aisance"
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator recalls being treated as the awaited guest for whom the whole household's machinery was set in motion, deemed fit to be admitted into the Guermantes milieu, and received with an ease that spared him the expected timidity.

appraisal_events.evidence: "elle pivota avec tant de justesse autour de moi que je trouvai son bras sur le mien et le plus naturellement encadré dans un rythme de mouvements précis et nobles"; "Mme de Guermantes avait peur qu'ayant regardé tant de tableaux, on ne me fatiguât"
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator admires the duchess's athletic, effortless grace in guiding him to table and her solicitude for his comfort, portraying her as an elegant and considerate hostess.
